quote.text: For a successful technology, reality must take precedence over public relations, for nature cannot be fooled.
quote.author: Richard P. Feynman, closing line of his personal appendix to the Rogers Commission report on the Challenger accident (1986)

stories.headline: Four Unhealthy regions became three overnight — and the hour-by-hour reading says the plume has swung west. The law written for exactly this has four files open from 2015 and no charges
stories.dek: Eleven years of open investigation, and a professor of environmental law explains why: the Act was built to need Jakarta’s cooperation, and Jakarta has never given it.

stories.headline: The American Razor is built in Japan and the Japanese Monarch is built in China. The one Japanese house that makes binoculars for the famous names has a website, a seventy-five-year history, and not one client’s name on it
stories.dek: Two numbers decide a pair of binoculars and neither is on the box. Here is how to read an unfamiliar one in ten seconds, at arm’s length, without taking the caps off.

stories.headline: Thailand has bought five million of its citizens a year of frontier artificial intelligence, and it is paying by the head, by the month, at twenty-four baht and six-nine-five-one satang
stories.dek: Everywhere else, AI sovereignty means chips and datacentres. Thailand went to the shop. The contract is a procurement, and the invoice line is a human being who logged in.

stories.headline: A mutual-defence pact two months old has been activated for the first time, and given a Pakistani general as its first secretary-general. What it has not yet been given is a single observed soldier
stories.dek: Islamabad has publicly called the troop numbers “invented”. Read the denial closely: it disputes the figures, and not the deployment.

stories.headline: Mistral trained a trillion-parameter model on its own European GPUs and published eleven benchmark wins. An independent harness has already measured one of them five points lower
stories.dek: Both of this week’s open-weight announcements ship no weights. The index that tracks frontier models currently files one of them under “proprietary”.

stories.kicker: The Home Lab · the cache that is 2.2× and also 0.35×
stories.headline: A pull request keeps the experts in host RAM and caches them on the card. On an RTX 5090 it runs 2.20 times faster — and a third as fast as baseline if you size the cache wrong
stories.dek: It is not merged. The headline multiple is the author’s own figure, and the one tester who looked closely reports the output diverging from the uncached path.

stories.kicker: The Kit · the number nobody has measured
stories.headline: Nothing’s flagship headphone has a Singapore price at last: $549. It also has a claim of “up to 46 dB” of noise cancellation that no laboratory on earth has yet checked
stories.dek: The maker’s own Singapore page says Pre-order and names no dispatch date. Four issues after launch, three of the review labs that would settle the question return 404.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Mount Joy, Pennsylvania
stories.headline: RGM’s first perpetual calendar since the nineteen-nineties costs US$39,900. The same house will sell you the same case, with a better movement and a longer reserve, for thirteen thousand nine hundred
stories.dek: The $26,000 between them buys fired enamel and a calendar module. It also buys a base movement that is a step down from the cheaper watch’s.

stories.headline: A film critics scored 46 beat a film they scored 67 by one thousand seven hundred and seventy-one dollars — and the estimate this desk printed on Tuesday had the result the other way round
stories.dek: No. 124 reported fifth place off Sunday estimates. The actuals moved it to fourth. Twenty-one points of critical opinion, two hundredths of one per cent of money.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · five thousand five hundred twelve-year-olds
stories.headline: A step counter strapped to 5,515 children found more walking, better mental health and measurably thicker cortex in two places. The effect size is 0.08, and that is the whole argument
stories.dek: The mean age in the study is 11.93 — the exact band that matters here. What the finding cannot do is tell you which way the arrow points.

stories.headline: Oil has fallen twenty-three per cent in three weeks and the long bond sold off anyway. The real-yield share of the move is no longer ninety-one per cent — it is a hundred and six
stories.dek: Inflation expectations have stopped explaining the sell-off and started working against it. What is left is supply — and it is repricing equities and bonds in the same direction at once.

stories.headline: Making curd takes thirty minutes and a lemon. The hobby begins at the other end, in a cold damp box, where you are not cooking but farming a microbial community and losing arguments with it
stories.dek: The most-followed voice in the hobby spent last August telling three hundred and fifty-five thousand subscribers they do not need the expensive thing.

stories.headline: Two hundred and thirty-nine trials were pooled to find the optimal exercise dose for back pain. The answer is about a hundred minutes a week — and the authors’ own abstract says the evidence does not support an optimal dose at all
stories.dek: Eighty-four per cent of the trials were at high risk of bias. The people who ran the numbers put the demolition in their own summary, which is rarer than the finding.

stories.headline: The marathon changed its name, closed its entries and sold out its local places while its own old website still showed last December
stories.dek: Every row here was put back to a promoter or a venue this morning. Two listings circulating elsewhere are wrong, and one is a festival whose organiser still says “stay tuned” about last year.
